jobDescription: responsibilities include creating clear and attainable project objectives and building the project specifications. You can work with Excel with your eyes closed. Analysing trends and driving traffic to our product is what energises you. You are a team player but you play by the rules only if it means the product is getting the attention. Interested much? Go on and apply then! Product Development You are someone who has completely come to terms with your phone buzzing all day. You are too good at finalizing deals and converting leads into customers comes naturally to you. Numbers excite you and you can do percentage maths in your head without breaking stride. You are an inter-seller and you never settle for low targets. Did we just define the perfect job role for you? Well, the ball is in your court now! Sales If 'No' is something you don't wish to hear at work, you should be here with this team. A business grows when great relationships are made. And imagine building steadfast relationships with suppliers all over the world sitting in India. How awesome would it be to grow Pickyourtrail's market share bigger than ever constantly and help customers travel across the globe with ease. Can you already picture yourself in this photo with our team? Well, we're just an email away! Supply & Category Management Life at Pickyourtrail Our Superheroes Parties and fun events Sports Day Festival Workspace Partnered with the best in the industry Planning an international holiday shouldn’t feel like a full-time job. Yet here we are — juggling tabs, comparing flights, second-guessing hotels, and wondering which activities are actually worth it. At Pickyourtrail, we built something better — a way to plan fully customised holidays that are effortless to create and unforgettable to experience. Our technology makes planning smarter — matching you with the best flights, stays, and activities in minutes — while our travel experts fine-tune every detail to reflect your pace, style, and budget. Add 24×7 support and transparent pricing, and you get something rare in travel: a planning experience that’s as smooth as the holiday itself. Because when a holiday is built around you, it doesn’t just turn out great — it turns out Sooper Hit. Over 1,50,000 travellers across 60+ destinations have already experienced the difference — seamless planning, real personalisation, and zero stress.
